prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A highly detailed, ornate pocket watch lies open on a dark, textured surface, its casing and frame crafted from intricate gold filigree adorned with sparkling blue and amber gemstones. The watch face is a miniature, fantastical landscape painting: a pair of twisted, leafless trees arch toward each other, their branches forming a delicate frame around a distant, misty mountain range. The left side of the scene is bathed in deep twilight blues, dotted with tiny stars, while the right side glows with the warm, golden light of a rising or setting sun, casting dramatic shadows and illuminating the landscape with a magical, ethereal quality. The composition is circular, with the landscape seamlessly blending into the ornate gold border, creating a sense of depth and wonder. The lighting is soft yet dramatic, highlighting the reflective surfaces of the gemstones and the metallic sheen of the gold, while the background remains subtly out of focus, emphasizing the central watch and its fantastical scene. The overall style is a blend of steampunk and high fantasy, with a cinematic, painterly quality and a rich, jewel-toned color palette.
